companyName: Fort St. James Green Energy Project
summary: Keep the existing Fort St. James Green Energy Project record deferred and do not publish a complete current owner schedule. Fresh direct evidence verifies a single 40 MW project, BioNorth Energy Limited Partnership's 2021-12-02 acquisition close, BioNorth Services Ltd. as Energy LP's general partner, four current parties to BioNorth Holdings Limited Partnership, Nak'azdli's 40% FY2024 interest at Holdings LP and Arrow's 40% FY2024 joint-venture disclosure at Energy LP. The two 40% facts sit at different unbridged partnership levels, and no direct source identifies the current 100% unit and beneficial-owner chain, maps 1323394 B.C. Unlimited Liability Company or BioNorth Services Ltd. to Nexus PMG, or proves a Nexus percentage. The production Fengate/Fund-IV ownership is stale and unsupported, but replacing it would require an inferred cap table, so no mutation is authorized.
resolvedFormerBlockers: BioNorth's current FY2026 report directly identifies the four parties to BioNorth Holdings Limited Partnership: Nak'azdli Development Corporation, 1323394 B.C. Unlimited Liability Company, Arrow Northern Services Inc. and BioNorth Services Ltd.

The 2026 British Columbia Gazette notice directly identifies BioNorth Services Ltd. as the general partner through which BioNorth Energy Limited Partnership applied for an environmental permit for the Fort St. James plant.

The corporate-registry notices directly verify company number 1323394 and its 2021-09-08 incorporation and company number 1312308's 2021-09-02 change from BioNorth Energy Ltd. to BioNorth Services Ltd.

Nak'azdli's FY2024 audited statements directly identify BioNorth Holdings Limited Partnership as a 40%-owned government business partnership and Nak'azdli Development Corporation as 100% owned by the First Nation.
Arrow's FY2024 image-only report directly identifies BioNorth Energy Limited Partnership as a 40% Arrow joint venture and the project as a 40 MW biomass plant.
The BioNorth acquisition release directly proves the project acquisition closed on 2021-12-02 and names Arrow, Nak'azdli Development Corporation and Nexus PMG as the buyer-side sponsors.
The 2013 financing release directly identifies Fengate Capital Management Ltd. and Dalkia Canada Inc. as historical developers and equity investors without naming Fengate Infrastructure Fund IV.
